reviews.text: The worst contractor I have ever hired. I'll keep this short. Josh and the team did my pool deck in polyaspartic coating in August 2024 and had the worst workmanship I have ever seen. What should have taken less than a week took more than 3. The mastic seal was applied laughably bad and I had a separate contractor come out and fix it. I have pictures attached of the 'professional' install Josh performed. There was never a supervisor at the job site and the workers took naps and surfed tik-tok while laying in my yard. He sold us on polyaspartic because it should not yellow in UV light. Almost the whole deck has turned yellow and must be redone because it was applied too thick. The lifetime warranty that is offered is not honored and he will not return your phone calls after he has been paid. I am going to have to have this whole project redone by an professional and litigate with Prime Pools to get my money back. See the attached pictures before you hire this company!
reviews.author: Evan Jarcy

reviews.text: Bad. Just bad. Hired Josh to do the job, payed 50% initial deposit, and then ghosts me. After I make a dispute with my bank he then wants to call back and use the same excuse as 2 weeks prior “we’re having problems with our phone lines” yet our conversation was already direct on his “cell phone”. Apparently he has more than 1 personal cell number. I then hired another company which it’s only $800 more than he would charge, they’re here now getting the job done no excuses. Did I mention now he “can’t” refund full initial 50% down payment of $1875 because he bought material already, come on now like any other company you buy something with out using you can definitely get your money back. But with that being said I still haven’t even received a partial refund, not just that but really, for only freaking $1875 you want to scam some one…??? Dude I’ll make that back easily, not just that but saves me money on you trying to cut corners and not wanting to brace a fiber glass pool that is going to get drained… guys here now have the pool draining and already braced on a sunny 2 days in a row…. So people be careful with Josh, don’t get me wrong he’s a good sales man and can almost convince you the sky is green. Good luck to you Josh and God bless
reviews.author: arturo villasenor

data.summary: The positive reviews are generic and lack credibility, while the negative reviews are highly specific, detailed, and align with the company's low ratings and poor BBB grade. Evidence points to significant operational problems, including taking deposits and ghosting, and failing to stand behind their work.
fake_signals: Lack of specific project details in positive reviews
Positive reviews clustered around same time period (a year ago)

negative_evidence: Workmanship so poor a separate contractor had to fix it
Owner unresponsive to correct issues after payment

authentic_signals: Specific, detailed complaints with dates and project types (polyaspartic coating)
Emotional authenticity in negative reviews (frustration, betrayal)
Mention of specific names (Josh) and actions (bank dispute)
